detail_text: Specifically, SOP#VPD/106-02, titled, “Entry and Exit Procedure for Aseptic Processing Area” which is applicable to all areas utilized in the manufacturing ofpharmaceuticals destined for the U.S. market, including the drugsle ae requires use of sterile garments and goggles prior to entry into the clean room area.
